lines.en: Mia, you look worried. Tell me everything about your meeting with the landlord.
lines.pt: Mia, você parece preocupada. Conte tudo sobre a reunião com o proprietário.

lines.en: Well, he said he was going to raise the rent in January. I could not believe it.
lines.pt: Bem, ele disse que ia aumentar o aluguel em janeiro. Não consegui acreditar.

lines.en: Did he give a reason? I hope you asked him why he had decided that.
lines.pt: Ele deu um motivo? Espero que você tenha perguntado por que decidiu isso.

lines.en: I did. He told me that the building needed a new roof and that costs had gone up.
lines.pt: Perguntei. Ele me disse que o prédio precisava de um telhado novo e que os custos tinham subido.

lines.en: That sounds fair, but did he ask whether you could pay the increase?
lines.pt: Parece justo, mas ele perguntou se você poderia pagar o aumento?

lines.en: No. He asked if I planned to stay another year, and I said I was not sure yet.
lines.pt: Não. Perguntou se eu pretendia ficar mais um ano, e eu disse que ainda não tinha certeza.

lines.en: Then he probably wants to keep you. Did he promise anything in return?
lines.pt: Então ele provavelmente quer manter você. Prometeu algo em troca?

lines.en: He promised to repaint the kitchen, and he suggested signing a two-year contract.
lines.pt: Prometeu repintar a cozinha e sugeriu assinar um contrato de dois anos.

lines.en: Interesting. My neighbour advised me never to sign anything without reading it twice.
lines.pt: Interessante. Meu vizinho me aconselhou a nunca assinar nada sem ler duas vezes.

lines.en: Good advice. He warned me not to wait too long, because other tenants were interested.
lines.pt: Bom conselho. Ele me avisou para não demorar demais, porque outros inquilinos estavam interessados.

lines.en: Then let us read the contract together tonight, and I will tell you what I think.
lines.pt: Então vamos ler o contrato juntas hoje à noite, e eu digo o que acho.

facts.big: He said he was going to raise the rent
facts.label: Discurso indireto: revisão
facts.sub: Revise said, told, asked, promised, suggested e warned: o tempo recua e cada verbo tem sua estrutura.

facts.label: disse que
facts.sub: Use said (that) + sujeito + verbo recuado: He said he was going to raise the rent. Say não leva pessoa direta; com pessoa, use said to me ou told me.

facts.label: disse a alguém
facts.sub: Use told me / told her + oração ou told me to + verbo: He told me that the building needed a roof. Told sempre leva pessoa depois, sem to.

compare.ask: He said he was going to raise the rent.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele disse que ia aumentar”, “perguntou se eu pretendia ficar” e “sugeriu assinar”.
compare.tip: Diga: “He said he was going to raise the rent.”
compare.us: Em inglês, cada verbo tem sua estrutura: said (that) + oração, told + pessoa, asked if / asked + palavra de pergunta, promised to, suggested + -ing, warned + pessoa + not to. O tempo recua um passo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: He told me that the building needed a roof is correct.

items.why: We say he told me or he said to me.

items.s: He asked if I planned to stay is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: He told me that the building needed a roof is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He said me that…”. → Falso (We say he told me or he said to me.)
He asked if I planned to stay is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A living room in Houston · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet Sunday evening in Houston. Alma and Clara sit on the sofa with two cups of tea. Clara met her landlord this afternoon. She remembers almost every word he said. Alma wants to hear the whole story. Today they review reported speech.

“Clara, you look worried. Tell me everything about your meeting with the landlord.” says Alma. “Well, he said he was going to raise the rent in January. I could not believe it.” says Clara. “Did he give a reason? I hope you asked him why he had decided that.” says Alma.
